params.query:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /(FATAL|PANIC|ERROR):/
| parse @message /\[(?<pid>\d+)\]\s+(?<sqlstate>[0-9A-Z]{5})\s*(?<ctx>\S+@\S+)?\s*(?<severity>FATAL|PANIC|ERROR):\s+(?<detail>.*)/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /(FATAL|PANIC|ERROR):/
| parse @message /\[(?<pid>\d+)\]\s+(?<sqlstate>[0-9A-Z]{5})\s*(?<ctx>\S+@\S+)?\s*(?<severity>FATAL|PANIC|ERROR):\s+(?<detail>.*)/
| stats count(*) as occurrences,
        earliest(@timestamp) as first_seen,
        latest(@timestamp) as last_seen
        by severity, sqlstate
| sort occurrences desc
| limit 50

fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /(FATAL|PANIC|ERROR):/
| parse @message /\[(?<pid>\d+)\]\s+(?<sqlstate>[0-9A-Z]{5})\s*(?<ctx>\S+@\S+)?\s*(?<severity>FATAL|PANIC|ERROR):\s+(?<detail>.*)/
| stats count(*) as occurrences by severity, sqlstate
| sort occurrences desc
| limit 50

fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /(?i)(too many clients|remaining connection slots|password authentication failed|no pg_hba.conf entry|terminating connection)/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

params.input: {"searched": "{{ Tasks.window.output.data.searched }}", "errors": {{ Tasks.logs_errors.output | default('') | to_json }}, "incident_patterns": {{ Tasks.logs_error_patterns.output | default('') | to_json }}, "baseline_patterns": {{ Tasks.logs_baseline_patterns.output | default('') | to_json }}, "connection_events": {{ Tasks.logs_connection_events.output | default('') | to_json }}}
